blocks.text: O'zbek tilida zarurat «kerak», «shart», «albatta ...ish kerak» bilan aytiladi: «Oyimga qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak». Ingliz tilida kuchli zarurat uchun **must** ishlatiladi: I **must** call my mother. **must** — modal fe'l: undan keyin fe'l `to` siz, barcha egalar bilan bir xil shakl (she **must**, «she musts» emas), inkor va savol `do` siz (→ 29–30-darslar). Bu darsda uchta yaqin, lekin ma'nosi butunlay boshqa ibora o'tiladi: **must** — «shart», **mustn't** — «mumkin emas», **don't need to** — «shart emas».

rows: I / you / we / they **don't need to** + fe'l
he / she / it **doesn't need to** + fe'l

blocks.text: **must** ko'pincha so'zlovchining o'z fikrini bildiradi: «men buni zarur deb bilaman». I **must** go to bed early tonight — «Bugun erta yotishim kerak» (o'zim shunday qaror qildim). You **must** try this cake! — kuchli tavsiya: «Bu tortni albatta tatib ko'ring!». Yozma qoidalar, e'lonlar va rasmiy talablarda ham **must** keladi: Passengers **must** show their tickets. Majburiyat tashqi sharoitdan kelganda inglizlar so'zlashuvda ko'pincha **have to** ishlatadi — ularning farqi 33-darsda.

items.text: I **must** go to the bank before it closes.
items.translation: Bank yopilishidan oldin u yerga **borishim kerak**.

items.text: You **must** visit Khiva — it's like a museum.
items.translation: Xivaga albatta **borishingiz kerak** — u xuddi muzeyga o'xshaydi.

items.text: Dogs **must** be on a lead in the park.

blocks.text: **mustn't** (= **must not**) — **taqiq**: bu ishni qilish noto'g'ri yoki xavfli, qilmang. You **mustn't** smoke here — «Bu yerda chekish mumkin emas». O'zbekchada bunday gap ko'pincha buyruq shaklida aytiladi: «Chekmang!», «Unutma!». Diqqat: **mustn't** hech qachon «shart emas» degani emas. «must» ga `not` qo'shilsa, zarurat yo'qolmaydi — aksincha, **qilmaslik** zarur bo'ladi.
don't need to / needn't: shart emas

**don't need to** — bu ishni qilish **zarur emas**: xohlasangiz qilasiz, xohlamasangiz yo'q. You **don't need to** come — «Kelishingiz shart emas» (lekin kelsangiz ham bo'ladi). U be bilan emas, oddiy fe'l kabi tuslanadi: he / she **doesn't need to** («he don't need to» emas), o'tgan zamonda — **didn't need to**. Britaniyada qisqa sinonimi **needn't** ham bor: You **needn't** come. **needn't** dan keyin `to` qo'yilmaydi, **don't need to** da esa `to` shart.

items.text: You **don't need to** shout. I can hear you.
Lola **doesn't need to** work on Saturdays.

blocks.text: Bir xil fe'l bilan uch xil ma'no chiqadi. O'zbekchadagi «kerak emas» ikki ma'noda ishlatilishi mumkin: «Kelishing kerak emas» — goh «shart emas», goh «kelma». Inglizchada esa ular aniq ajratiladi, chalkashtirib yuborilsa, ma'no teskari bo'lib qoladi.

**must** ning o'tgan zamon shakli yo'q. «Kecha ishlashim kerak edi» — I **had to** work yesterday (→ 33-dars, have to). Savol ham **must** bilan kam beriladi (Must I ...? — rasmiy); kundalik nutqda **Do I need to ...?** yoki **Do I have to ...?** deyiladi. Kelajak uchun **must** to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatiladi: I **must** get up early tomorrow.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You mustn't come early, we start at ten.» (ma'nosi «shart emas» bo'lsa) → **You don't need to come early.**; «I must to go.» → **I must go.**; «He musts work.» → **He must work.**; «You don't must smoke.» → **You mustn't smoke.**; «She doesn't need come.» → **She doesn't need to come.** (`to` shart); «You needn't to worry.» → **You needn't worry.**

Eslab qolish uchun svetofor: **must** — yashil chiroq, albatta yuring; **mustn't** — qizil chiroq, to'xtang; **don't need to** — chiroq yo'q, o'zingiz tanlaysiz. Maslahat (biroz yumshoqroq «kerak») uchun **should** ishlatiladi — 32-dars.

items: **must** + fe'l — kerak, shart (so'zlovchining fikri, qoida, kuchli tavsiya): I **must** go.
**mustn't** + fe'l — mumkin emas, qilmang (taqiq): You **mustn't** touch it.
**don't / doesn't need to** + fe'l — shart emas (ixtiyoriy): You **don't need to** pay.
**needn't** + fe'l — don't need to bilan bir xil, `to` siz: You **needn't** wait.
o'tgan zamon — **had to** (33-dars) va **didn't need to**; savol — **Do I need to ...?**

examples.title: **must**: it's necessary (I think so)
examples.description: **must** + fe'l = «...ishim kerak», «shart». So'zlovchi o'zi zarur deb hisoblaydi; ikkinchi shaxs bilan — kuchli tavsiya ham bo'ladi.

sentences.text: I **must** call my mother tonight — it's her birthday.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun oyimga **qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak** — bugun uning tug'ilgan kuni.

sentences.text: It's late. We **must** go home now.
sentences.translation: Kech bo'ldi. Endi uyga **ketishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: You **must** try my grandmother's plov — it's the best in Tashkent!
sentences.translation: Buvimning palovini albatta **tatib ko'rishingiz kerak** — u Toshkentdagi eng zo'r palov!

sentences.text: Aziz **must** finish his project by Friday.
sentences.translation: Aziz loyihasini jumagacha **tugatishi shart**.

sentences.text: My car is making a strange noise. I **must** take it to a mechanic.
sentences.translation: Mashinam g'alati ovoz chiqaryapti. Uni ustaga **olib borishim kerak**.

sentences.text: Before the trip Sarah **must** renew her passport.
sentences.translation: Sayohatdan oldin Sara pasportini **yangilashi kerak**.

sentences.text: The plants look very dry. Somebody **must** water them today.
sentences.translation: O'simliklar juda qurib qolganga o'xshaydi. Bugun kimdir ularni **sug'orishi kerak**.

sentences.text: I've got a terrible headache, so I **must** lie down for a while.
sentences.translation: Boshim qattiq og'riyapti, shuning uchun biroz **yotib olishim kerak**.

sentences.text: We **must** remember to buy bread on the way home.
sentences.translation: Uyga ketayotib non olishni **unutmasligimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has an important exam tomorrow, so he **must** get a good night's sleep.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning ertaga muhim imtihoni bor, shuning uchun u kechasi yaxshilab **uxlab olishi kerak**.

examples.title: **must** in rules and notices
examples.description: Qoidalar, e'lonlar va rasmiy talablarda **must** = «shart», **must not** = «mumkin emas». Bunday gaplar ko'pincha yozma bo'ladi.

sentences.text: All passengers **must** wear seat belts.
sentences.translation: Barcha yo'lovchilar xavfsizlik kamarini **taqishi shart**.

sentences.text: Visitors **must** sign in at reception.
sentences.translation: Tashrif buyuruvchilar qabulxonada **ro'yxatdan o'tishi shart**.

sentences.text: Students **must** switch off their phones during lessons.
sentences.translation: Talabalar dars paytida telefonlarini **o'chirib qo'yishlari shart**.

sentences.text: In Britain drivers **must** drive on the left.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada haydovchilar yo'lning chap tomonidan **yurishi shart**.

sentences.text: The rent **must** be paid on the first day of every month.
sentences.translation: Ijara haqi har oyning birinchi kuni **to'lanishi shart**.

sentences.text: Children under ten **must** be with an adult in the pool.
sentences.translation: O'n yoshgacha bolalar basseynda kattalar bilan **bo'lishi shart**.

sentences.text: Every application **must** include a copy of your passport.
sentences.translation: Har bir arizaga pasport nusxasi **ilova qilinishi shart**.

sentences.text: According to the rules, players **must** arrive thirty minutes before the match.
sentences.translation: Qoidaga ko'ra, o'yinchilar o'yindan o'ttiz daqiqa oldin **kelishlari shart**.

sentences.text: At this school pupils **must** wear a uniform.
sentences.translation: Bu maktabda o'quvchilar maktab formasini **kiyishlari shart**.

sentences.text: Food and drink **must not** be taken into the library.
sentences.translation: Kutubxonaga ovqat va ichimlik **olib kirish mumkin emas**.

examples.title: **mustn't**: don't do it!
examples.description: **mustn't** — taqiq: «...ish mumkin emas», «...mang!». Bu ishni qilmaslik zarur — «shart emas» degani emas.

sentences.text: You **mustn't** touch the oven — it's very hot.
sentences.translation: Pechkaga **tegmang** — u juda qizigan.

sentences.text: We **mustn't** be late for the interview.
sentences.translation: Suhbatga **kechikmasligimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Patients **mustn't** eat anything before the operation.
sentences.translation: Bemorlar operatsiyadan oldin hech narsa **yemasliklari kerak**.

sentences.text: I **mustn't** forget Dilnoza's birthday this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil Dilnozaning tug'ilgan kunini **unutmasligim kerak**.

sentences.text: Children, you **mustn't** play near the road!
sentences.translation: Bolalar, yo'l yaqinida **o'ynamanglar**!

sentences.text: This is a secret. You **mustn't** tell anybody.
sentences.translation: Bu sir. Hech kimga **aytmang**.

sentences.text: Drivers **mustn't** use their phones while they are driving.
sentences.translation: Haydovchilarga mashina haydayotganda telefondan **foydalanish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: James **mustn't** eat sugar — he has diabetes.
sentences.translation: Jeyms shakar **yemasligi kerak** — unda qandli diabet bor.

sentences.text: In the museum visitors **mustn't** touch the paintings.
sentences.translation: Muzeyda tashrif buyuruvchilar rasmlarga **tegmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Madina, you **mustn't** go out in the cold with such a high temperature.
sentences.translation: Madina, isitmang shunchalik baland, sovuqda tashqariga **chiqmasliging kerak**.

examples.title: **don't need to** / **needn't**: it isn't necessary
examples.description: **don't need to** (he/she — **doesn't need to**) va **needn't** = «...ish shart emas», «...masa ham bo'ladi». Taqiq yo'q — xohlasangiz qilasiz.

sentences.text: You **don't need to** bring any food — we've got plenty.
sentences.translation: Hech qanday ovqat **olib kelishingiz shart emas** — bizda yetarli.

sentences.text: Tomorrow is Sunday, so I **don't need to** get up early.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yakshanba, shuning uchun erta **turishim shart emas**.

sentences.text: Aziz **doesn't need to** study tonight — his exam is next month.
sentences.translation: Aziz bugun kechqurun **o'qishi shart emas** — imtihoni kelasi oy.

sentences.text: We **don't need to** take a taxi. The hotel is very close.
sentences.translation: Taksiga **o'tirishimiz shart emas**. Mehmonxona juda yaqin.

sentences.text: You **needn't** worry about the children; they're with my mother.
sentences.translation: Bolalar haqida **xavotir olmasangiz ham bo'ladi**: ular oyim bilan.

sentences.text: Emma **doesn't need to** wear glasses for reading any more.
sentences.translation: Emma endi o'qiganda ko'zoynak **taqmasa ham bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: My flat has a washing machine, so I **don't need to** go to the launderette.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramda kir yuvish mashinasi bor, shuning uchun kirxonaga **borishim shart emas**.

sentences.text: Don't run — we **don't need to** hurry. The film starts at nine.
sentences.translation: Yugurmang — **shoshilishimiz shart emas**. Film soat to'qqizda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Visitors from some countries **don't need to** get a visa for Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi davlatlardan keladigan mehmonlarga O'zbekistonga **viza olish shart emas**.

sentences.text: Thanks for the offer, but you **needn't** drive me to the airport. I can take the bus.
sentences.translation: Taklifingiz uchun rahmat, lekin meni aeroportga **olib borishingiz shart emas**. Avtobusda keta olaman.

examples.title: **must** ↔ **don't need to**
examples.description: Zarur va zarur emas yonma-yon: **must** — «shart», **don't need to** — «shart emas» (o'zingiz bilasiz).

sentences.text: At the airport you **must** show your passport, but you **don't need to** print your ticket.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda pasportingizni **ko'rsatishingiz shart**, chiptangizni esa **chop etishingiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: I **must** buy some milk, but I **don't need to** buy bread — we've got some.
sentences.translation: Sut **olishim kerak**, non esa **olishim shart emas** — uyda bor.

sentences.text: Madina **must** wear a suit at work, but on Fridays she **doesn't need to**.
sentences.translation: Madina ishda kostyum **kiyishi shart**, lekin juma kunlari **shart emas**.

sentences.text: Tom **must** see a doctor about his back, but he **doesn't need to** stay in hospital.
sentences.translation: Tom beli yuzasidan shifokorga **ko'rinishi kerak**, lekin kasalxonada **yotishi shart emas**.

sentences.text: You **must** fill in this form, but you **needn't** write your phone number.
sentences.translation: Bu anketani **to'ldirishingiz shart**, lekin telefon raqamingizni **yozishingiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: The exam starts at nine: students **must** be there at half past eight, and they **don't need to** bring pens.
sentences.translation: Imtihon soat to'qqizda boshlanadi: talabalar sakkiz yarimda u yerda **bo'lishi shart**, ruchka esa **olib kelishlari shart emas**.

sentences.text: In this job you **don't need to** speak English, but you **must** be good with computers.
sentences.translation: Bu ishda inglizcha **bilish shart emas**, lekin kompyuterni yaxshi **bilishingiz shart**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **doesn't need to** cook tonight because his wife is cooking, but he **must** wash the dishes.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bugun kechqurun **ovqat pishirishi shart emas**, chunki xotini pishiryapti, lekin idishlarni **yuvishi shart**.

sentences.text: We **don't need to** book a table on Monday, but on Saturday we **must**.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni stol **band qilishimiz shart emas**, shanba kuni esa **shart**.

sentences.text: Children **must** go to school, but they **don't need to** go to music lessons — it's their choice.
sentences.translation: Bolalar maktabga **borishi shart**, musiqa darslariga esa **borishlari shart emas** — bu ularning tanlovi.

examples.title: **mustn't** ↔ **don't need to**: forbidden or optional?
examples.description: Eng muhim farq: **mustn't** — «mumkin emas, qilmang» (taqiq), **don't need to** — «shart emas, xohlasangiz qiling». O'zbekcha «kerak emas» ikkalasiga o'xshaydi — ehtiyot bo'ling.

sentences.text: You **mustn't** shout in the hospital, but you **don't need to** whisper.
sentences.translation: Kasalxonada **baqirish mumkin emas**, lekin **pichirlashingiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: We **mustn't** be late for the train, but we **don't need to** be there an hour early.
sentences.translation: Poyezdga **kechikmasligimiz kerak**, lekin bir soat oldin **borishimiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: Your passport is important — you **mustn't** lose it. But you **don't need to** carry it every day.
sentences.translation: Pasportingiz muhim — uni **yo'qotmang**. Lekin uni har kuni olib **yurishingiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: Patients **mustn't** eat before the blood test, but they **don't need to** stop drinking water.
sentences.translation: Bemorlar qon tahlilidan oldin **ovqat yemasligi kerak**, lekin suv ichishni **to'xtatishlari shart emas**.

sentences.text: Aziz, you **don't need to** finish the soup — just eat as much as you want.
sentences.translation: Aziz, sho'rvani **tugatishing shart emas** — qancha xohlasang, shuncha ye.

sentences.text: On this road drivers **mustn't** go faster than sixty kilometres an hour.
sentences.translation: Bu yo'lda haydovchilar soatiga oltmish kilometrdan tez **yurishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: It's a casual party, so you **don't need to** wear a tie.
sentences.translation: Bu oddiy bazm, shuning uchun **galstuk taqish shart emas**.

sentences.text: The baby is sleeping, so we **mustn't** make any noise.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq uxlayapti, shuning uchun **shovqin qilmasligimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: You **mustn't** tell Emma about the surprise party. — Don't worry, I won't.
sentences.translation: Emmaga kutilmagan bazm haqida **aytmang**. — Xavotir olmang, aytmayman.

sentences.text: You **don't need to** knock — just come in. But you **mustn't** come in when the red light is on.
sentences.translation: Eshikni **taqillatishingiz shart emas** — kiravering. Lekin qizil chiroq yonib turganda **kirish mumkin emas**.

examples.title: Questions: **Do I need to ...?** **Must I ...?**
examples.description: Savolda ko'pincha **Do I need to ...?** («...ishim kerakmi?»), **Must I ...?** — rasmiyroq. Javob: **Yes, you must.** / **No, you don't need to.**

sentences.text: **Do I need to** bring my passport? — Yes, you **must** bring it.
sentences.translation: Pasportimni **olib kelishim kerakmi**? — Ha, **olib kelishingiz shart**.

sentences.text: **Do we need to** book tickets in advance? — No, you **don't need to**.
sentences.translation: Chiptalarni oldindan **band qilishimiz kerakmi**? — Yo'q, **shart emas**.

sentences.text: **Does** Aziz **need to** see a doctor? — I think he **must**. His temperature is very high.
sentences.translation: Aziz shifokorga **ko'rinishi kerakmi**? — Menimcha, **shart**. Isitmasi juda baland.

sentences.text: What time **must** we be at the airport? — Two hours before the flight.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda soat nechada **bo'lishimiz kerak**? — Parvozdan ikki soat oldin.

sentences.text: **Must** I wear a tie to the interview? — Well, you **don't need to**, but it's a good idea.
sentences.translation: Suhbatga galstuk **taqishim shartmi**? — Aslida **shart emas**, lekin taqsangiz yaxshi.

sentences.text: Mum, **do I need to** tidy my room now? — Yes, you **must** do it before dinner.
sentences.translation: Oyi, xonamni hozir **yig'ishtirishim kerakmi**? — Ha, kechki ovqatdan oldin **yig'ishtirishing shart**.

sentences.text: **Do** visitors **need to** pay for the museum? — No, they **don't** — it's free on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Muzeyga kirish uchun **pul to'lash kerakmi**? — Yo'q, **shart emas** — yakshanba kunlari bepul.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **must** I fill in all the boxes on this form? — Only the first five.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu anketadagi barcha kataklarni **to'ldirishim shartmi**? — Faqat birinchi beshtasini.

sentences.text: **Does** Madina **need to** learn Russian for her new job? — No, she **doesn't**. English is enough.
sentences.translation: Madina yangi ishi uchun rus tilini **o'rganishi kerakmi**? — Yo'q, **shart emas**. Ingliz tili yetarli.

sentences.text: Sarah, **do we need to** take anything to the picnic? — Just some fruit, and you **mustn't** forget the blanket!
sentences.translation: Sara, piknikka biror narsa **olib borishimiz kerakmi**? — Ozgina meva, xolos. Va **adyolni unutmanglar**!

examples.title: Mixed: **must**, **mustn't**, **don't need to**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: kundalik vaziyatlarda zarurat, taqiq va ixtiyoriylik — **must**, **mustn't**, **don't need to**, **needn't**.

sentences.text: At my new job I **must** start at eight, but I **don't need to** wear a uniform.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishimda soat sakkizda **boshlashim shart**, lekin forma **kiyishim shart emas**.

sentences.text: Bekzod, you **mustn't** play games on your phone at the table.
sentences.translation: Bekzod, dasturxon atrofida telefonda **o'yin o'ynama**.

sentences.text: Tourists **don't need to** carry cash in Tashkent — most shops accept cards.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda sayyohlarga **naqd pul olib yurish shart emas** — ko'p do'konlar kartani qabul qiladi.

sentences.text: Before you start the exam, you **must** write your name at the top of the page.
sentences.translation: Imtihonni boshlashdan oldin sahifaning yuqorisiga ismingizni **yozishingiz shart**.

sentences.text: The water in this river isn't clean: you **mustn't** drink it.
sentences.translation: Bu daryoning suvi toza emas: uni **ichish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **needn't** buy a new dress for the wedding — she can borrow her sister's.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza to'y uchun yangi ko'ylak **olmasa ham bo'ladi** — opasinikini olib tura oladi.

sentences.text: I **must** stop eating so much bread — my jeans are getting tight!
sentences.translation: Bunchalik ko'p non **yeyishni bas qilishim kerak** — jinsim tor bo'lib qolyapti!

sentences.text: **Do we need to** change trains in London? — No, we **don't**; this train goes straight to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Londonda poyezd **almashtirishimiz kerakmi**? — Yo'q, **shart emas**: bu poyezd to'g'ri Oksfordga boradi.

sentences.text: Remember: you **mustn't** open the door to strangers, and you **must** call me if there's a problem.
sentences.translation: Esingda bo'lsin: notanish odamlarga eshikni **ochma**, muammo bo'lsa menga albatta **qo'ng'iroq qil**.

sentences.text: You **don't need to** thank me — it was a pleasure to help.
sentences.translation: Menga **rahmat aytishingiz shart emas** — yordam berganimdan xursandman.
